chunks: With the clear proofs and the Books; and We have sent down to you the Reminder so that you may make clear to the people what was sent down to them, and that they might reflect.
ai.seo_question: What is the purpose of the Quran as a Reminder (Adh-Dhikr) according to Surah An-Nahl?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Prophet’s (SAW) role as the active interpreter (Mubayyin) of the Quran, a function later extended by the Imams as the inheritors of this explanatory authority. It highlights the transition from the 'Zubur' (earlier scriptures) to the final, comprehensive 'Dhikr', inviting rational reflection (Tafakkur) as a path to spiritual clarity.
